caseResults.observed: HTTP 200 success; backend 1; Coordinator receives inert_decoy, no Content-Length and no Transfer-Encoding. Configuring mapped_inert_decoy cannot match this reverse-mapped request.
caseResults.issueDisposition: leave #48 open; the former 415 is resolved for this framing, but the prescribed mapped-name enforcement assertion fails.

caseResults.observed: Both HTTP 200 / -32008; backend zero; Sentinel-only warn detections.

Client sends Transfer-Encoding: chunked with no length. Both headers are absent at the Coordinator boundary. Clean traffic is inspected/forwarded instead of 415; observe has no warn inspection_skipped. A chunked decoy still returns -32008. The result persists with only Coordinator and without the probe.
caseResults.issueDisposition: file new runtime admission defect; no admission change made
caseResults.limitation: Finite uploads only; no unbounded-upload, timeout, OOM or production DoS claim.

caseResults.observed: Cached discovery is HTTP 200/backend zero. With validateToolSchema false, tools/list reaches the backend once and the Coordinator response probe captures the declared-length 1056-byte response.
Whole-chain HTTP 200 / -32600 from MCP Support, backend zero, no Coordinator probe event. Not a Coordinator 415.

ABAC output drops additionalProperties:false, but removing both access policies still leaves four inputSchema findings while the captured pre-Schema-Validation descriptors equal the downloaded pin. Intermediate normalization is real but not a sufficient explanation. The remaining discrepancy is inside the included validation/pin path; its internal representation was not established.

Seeding adds description drift to exactly three previously unseeded tools. The asset-planted inert_decoy gains no description drift. Disabled seeding preserves all descriptions and the planted breadcrumb; four unrelated inputSchema findings remain. No bare removal is used as evidence of seeding.

Sentinel blocks or forwards as configured; sanitize blocks requests with -32008; declared-length honeytoken response is redacted; undeclared response is forwarded unredacted with warn response_inspection_skipped as documented.
